es.title: Germanio
es.extract: El germanio es un elemento químico con número atómico 32, y símbolo Ge perteneciente al período 4 de la tabla periódica de los elementos.

en.title: Germanium
en.extract: Germanium is a chemical element; it has the symbol Ge and atomic number 32. It is lustrous, hard-brittle, grayish-white and similar in appearance to silicon. It is a metalloid in the carbon group that is chemically similar to silicon. Like silicon, germanium naturally reacts and forms complexes with oxygen in nature.
